description: Parent page commands (Pages panel menu > Parent Pages): base a parent on another parent, save a document spread as a parent, load parent pages from another document, select unused parents (and list them), copy a parent to another open document (Move Parent), allow or prevent overrides of parent items, or offset the parent page overlay on a resized page

allow.description: For allow_overrides: allow (true) or prevent (false) overriding the items on document pages

basedOn.description: For based_on: the parent to base it on, or "None"

clash.description: For load: when a parent of the same name exists, rename the loaded one or replace the existing one

filePath.description: For load: the InDesign document (.indd or .indt) to load parents from

itemIds.description: For allow_overrides: ids of items on parent spreads

offsetX.description: For parent_overlay: horizontal offset of the parent page, mm (0 with offsetY 0 clears it)

offsetY.description: For parent_overlay: vertical offset of the parent page, mm

parent.description: Parent spread full name, e.g. "A-Parent" (for based_on and move_to_document)

toDocument.description: For move_to_document: name of the open document to copy the parent into

name: manage_parent_pages
title: Manage Parent Pages
